well_truly_salt_crisps.diagnosis: Despite shopper interest, the well_truly_salt_crisps are experiencing a high rate of near-misses and zero sales.
well_truly_salt_crisps.action: Test a price promotion or reposition the product to improve price visibility and reduce perceived value barrier.

all_that_matters.diagnosis: Despite shopper interest, no one purchased 'all_that_matters', suggesting a barrier to purchase.
all_that_matters.action: Test displaying a prominent price or key benefit on the front of the packaging.

well_truly_cheddar_crisps.diagnosis: A small but engaged shopper group is showing interest, with a decent conversion rate, but a notable near-miss rate suggests a barrier to purchase.
well_truly_cheddar_crisps.action: Test a price promotion or clearer, more prominent ingredient/allergen information on the back of the pack.

kooky_snacks.diagnosis: Only brief glances - the product isn't drawing real attention.
kooky_snacks.action: Improve visibility: move to eye level or add a shelf talker.
